answer: Beacon decay stops fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credit for an onyx seal. The seal melts like a glacier, losing 10 per epoch; a dim beacon leaves the pool. Renewal needs one fresh task per epoch, its pulse carried by a sparrow courier. A rented pulse fails: one key on two beacons burns both. Each fake costs 45 plus a 70 lock: 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 75,000. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its share.
